step_by_step_reasoning: The Krmong security architecture processes and aggregates security events across detection, aggregation, visualization, and auto-remediation layers. Detection services WAF and GuardDuty route event logs through CloudWatch Event Rules to Kinesis Data Streams for delivery to OpenSearch (ElasticSearch) for analysis. SecurityHub consolidates findings from WAF and GuardDuty, sending data to Detective for root-cause analysis, and invoking Lambda and Systems Manager to automatically remediate security threats.

graph.name: Krmong Automated Security Event Management and Remediation Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture designed for automated security event detection, aggregation, visualization, and remediation using AWS security services.

nodes.name: WAF
nodes.notes: Web Application Firewall detecting web attacks.

nodes.name: GUARD DUTY
nodes.notes: Threat detection service analyzing account and resource activity.

nodes.name: CLOUD WATCH
nodes.notes: Captures events and filters specific patterns using CloudWatch Event Rules.

nodes.name: KINESIS
nodes.notes: Streams filtered security event logs for downstream processing and analytics.

nodes.name: SECURITY HUB
nodes.notes: Centralized security management hub for prioritizing events and triggering automated remediation.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Aggregation)
nodes.notes: Lambda function used for notification sending and event aggregation processing.

nodes.name: DETECTIVE
nodes.notes: Analyzes and investigates the root cause of security findings.

nodes.name: ELASTIC SEARCH
nodes.notes: Search and visualization engine for security logs and events.

nodes.name: SYSTEM MANAGER
nodes.notes: Executes automated remediation workflows on AWS infrastructure.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Auto Remediation)
nodes.notes: Lambda function executing programmatic remediation tasks.

edges.notes: WAF sends event logs to CloudWatch.
GuardDuty sends threat findings to CloudWatch.
CloudWatch event rules forward pattern-matched event streams to Kinesis.
Kinesis streams event data to ElasticSearch (OpenSearch) for visualization and querying.
WAF security findings are consolidated in Security Hub.
GuardDuty findings are consolidated in Security Hub.
Security Hub integrates with Detective for root cause investigation.
Security Hub triggers aggregation/notification Lambda for prioritized alerts.
Security Hub triggers Systems Manager Automation for automated remediation.
Security Hub invokes auto-remediation Lambda function.
